$comment: The DAK's data dictionary (component 5 of a WHO SMART Guidelines DAK). This demonstrator defines no logical model of its own (issue #33): each data set is a model of an existing specification (WHO SMART Trust PHW, WHO SMART Trust, the WHO Immunization guide, IHE ITI VHL), named by its canonical, with the elements the journeys use as that model defines them. tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py writes the code lists' CodeSystems and ValueSets (input/fsh/dak/) and the Data Dictionary page (input/pagecontent/dictionary.md) from this file; tools/repo-checks/repo_checks.py checks that every process, task, requirement and FHIR artifact it names exists. A model's `serves` names the BPMN tasks that record or read its data; an element's `maps` says where this guide realises it. A data element is named <model id>.<path>, for example IMMZImmunization.primarySource.

codeLists.title: Result of reading a DVC
codeLists.description: What the HCERT library returns for one scanned DVC: a verified result, a failed result naming the step and reason (STT-VER-008), or the distinct result of the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011).

codes.definition: Every step of verification passed (STT-VER-001).
Verification stopped at a step, for a reason from the closed set of STT-VER-008.
The payload was read by read-unverified, with no trust lookup or signature check (STT-VER-011).

codeLists.title: Verification steps
codeLists.description: The steps of DVC verification in the order they run (STT-VER-001), as the HCERT library names them in its typed result (STT-VER-008).

codes.definition: The HC1: context prefix and version.
Base45 decoding of the QR text.
ZLIB decompression, within limits.
Parsing the COSE_Sign1 structure.
The protected and unprotected headers.
Finding the signer's certificate by kid on the trust list.
Checking the signature with the signer's key.
Checking the signer's certificate may sign this kind of certificate.
Reading the CWT claim set.
Checking issued-at and expiry against the verifier's clock.
Finding the hcert claim and its subclaim.
Reading the payload against its logical model.

codeLists.title: Verification failure reasons
codeLists.description: The closed set of reasons a DVC fails verification, shared by the Kotlin and Rust HCERT libraries (STT-VER-008).

codes.definition: The text does not start with the HC1: prefix.
The context identifier names a version the verifier does not support.
The text is not valid Base45.
The compressed bytes do not decompress.
A decode limit (size or depth) was exceeded.
The bytes are not a well-formed COSE_Sign1.
A COSE header is missing or not as required.
The signature algorithm is not one the verifier accepts.
No certificate on the verifier's copy of the trust list has the kid (STT-VER-006).
The signature does not verify with any certificate with the kid.
The signer's certificate may not sign this kind of certificate.
The certificate's expiry has passed.
The certificate's issued-at time is in the future.
The claim set has no hcert claim.
The hcert claim has more subclaims than the verifier accepts.
The payload does not conform to its logical model.

codeLists.title: What a scanned DVC becomes in the record
codeLists.description: The outcome of decision table TD.DT.01 for one scanned DVC.

codes.definition: Recorded from its primary source, with provenance of the verification.
Kept as reported by the family (primarySource false); not counted by the schedule.
The certificate is not evidence of a dose; the step and reason are recorded.
Nothing could be read from the QR; the card is treated as paper.

codeLists.title: How an imported dose got its national schedule code
codeLists.description: The outcome of decision table TD.DT.02 (STD-SEM-001).

codes.definition: The issuer's product code has an equivalent schedule code in the national map.
The map had no entry; the clinician confirmed the equivalent, and the decision is added to the map.
No equivalent is known; the issuer's code is kept as it is and shown as unmapped.
The dose was not verified, so it was not imported and not mapped.

codeLists.title: Why a shared link released nothing
codeLists.description: The refusal reasons of decision table TD.DT.05 (STD-ACC-001).

codes.definition: The holder withdrew the link before it expired.
The request came after the expiry the holder chose.
The passcode given does not match the one the holder set.

models.title: DVC HCERT payload (PreQual)
models.description: The minimal Digital Vaccination Certificate payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW, with the vaccine coded by its WHO PreQual product id. J1's birth hospital builds one per dose; J2 reads it unverified on a home visit and J3 reads it again when the clinic verifies it.

elements.label: Name
elements.definition: The holder's name.

elements.label: Date of birth
elements.definition: The holder's date of birth.

elements.label: Sex
elements.definition: The holder's sex.

elements.label: Nationality
elements.definition: The holder's nationality.

elements.label: National identification document
elements.definition: The holder's national identification document number; a newborn has none.
maps: not realised in the examples (a newborn has none)

elements.label: National ID document type
elements.definition: The type of that document.

elements.label: Parent or guardian name
elements.definition: The parent or guardian, for a holder with no identity document such as a newborn (STT-PAY-005).

elements.label: Vaccine details
elements.definition: The dose the certificate is for (DVCMinVaccineDetailsPreQual).

elements.label: Vaccine product id
elements.definition: The product given, as its WHO PreQual product id.

elements.label: Date of vaccination
elements.definition: The date the dose was given.

elements.label: Supervising clinician
elements.definition: The clinician who gave or supervised the dose.

elements.label: Certificate issuer id
elements.definition: The organization that issued the certificate.

elements.label: Batch number
elements.definition: The batch (lot) of the vaccine given.

elements.label: Version
elements.definition: The version of the certificate template.

models.title: CBOR Web Token (CWT)
models.description: The CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust that carries a DVC payload: the COSE header that names the signing key, the CWT claims and the signature. J1 signs one per dose with Taifafeki's key; J3 checks each against the trust list.

elements.label: COSE header
elements.definition: The COSE header (COSEHeader).

elements.label: Algorithm (alg)
elements.definition: The signature algorithm.

elements.label: Key identifier (kid)
elements.definition: Identifies the document signer certificate on the trust list that verifies the DVC (J1: 916ffa567c0f44a2).

elements.label: CWT payload
elements.definition: The CWT claims (CWTPayload).

elements.label: Issuer (iss)
elements.definition: The trust-network participant whose key signs the DVC (J1: XXR).

elements.label: Expires at (exp)
elements.definition: When the DVC stops verifying, where the issuer sets an expiry.

elements.label: Issued at (iat)
elements.definition: When the DVC was signed.

elements.label: Health certificate (hcert)
elements.definition: The hcert claim, which carries the DVC payload (DVCMinPreQual).

elements.label: Signature
elements.definition: The signature over the Sig_structure, made with the signer's key.

models.title: IMMZ.C4 Create client record (= IMMZ.C5.3 Update client details)
models.description: The client record of the WHO Immunization DAK, which also serves its IMMZ.C5.3 Update client details activity. J2's community health worker registers the newborn with it and updates the child's details later; J3's dose schedule is computed from its date of birth.

elements.label: Unique identifier
elements.definition: Unique identifier for the client, according to the country's policies (J2: a temporary id until the clinic issues one).

elements.label: Name
elements.definition: The full name of the client.

elements.label: First name
elements.definition: Client's first name or given name.

elements.label: Family name
elements.definition: Client's family name or last name.

elements.label: Sex
elements.definition: Documentation of a specific instance of sex information for the client.

elements.label: Date of birth
elements.definition: Client's date of birth, or an assigned one for administrative purposes.

elements.label: Age
elements.definition: The client's age, calculated from the date of birth and the visit date.

elements.label: Caregivers
elements.definition: The client's caregivers, such as the mother who shows the foreign cards.

elements.label: Caregiver's full name
elements.definition: The full name of the client's caregiver.

elements.label: Contact phone number
elements.definition: Client's phone number, landline or mobile.

elements.label: Address
elements.definition: Client's home address; J2 records the household.

models.title: IMMZ Immunization
models.description: The Immunization profile of the WHO Immunization guide (IMMZ.D Administer vaccine). J2 saves each dose read from a foreign card with it as reported (primarySource false); J3 imports each verified dose with it (primarySource true), adds the national code beside the product code and counts it toward the schedule.

elements.label: Status
elements.definition: completed for every dose of the journeys.

elements.label: Vaccine code
elements.definition: The product as signed (its PreQual product id) and, once mapped, the national schedule code beside it.

elements.label: Patient
elements.definition: The child (IMMZC4).

elements.label: Date of vaccination
elements.definition: When the dose was given.

elements.label: Primary source
elements.definition: true when the dose comes from a DVC that verified; false when it was read from a card without verifying it.

elements.label: Information source
elements.definition: Who reported a dose that is not from its primary source: the caregiver.

elements.label: Batch number
elements.definition: The batch (lot) of the vaccine given.

elements.label: Protocol applied
elements.definition: The series and the dose number in it.

elements.label: Dose number
elements.definition: The dose's number in its series.

elements.label: Location
elements.definition: Where the dose was given, with its country of vaccination.

ig.title: IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL)
ig.version: ci build, branch jul26 (not yet released)

models.title: VHL Payload
models.description: The payload of a Verifiable Health Link (IHE ITI VHL), carried at HCERT claim key 5. J4.0 generates one per QR code, one for each family member; J4.1 reads it from the QR and requests the manifest it points to.

elements.label: Manifest URL
elements.definition: The manifest URL, a FHIR search on the List folder that holds this member's documents.

elements.label: Decryption key
elements.definition: The 32-byte key, base64url, that decrypts the documents the manifest returns.

elements.label: Expires at
elements.definition: When the link stops working: the end of the period the holder chose.

elements.label: Flags
elements.definition: L (long-term) and P (a passcode is required); J4's links carry P.

elements.label: Label
elements.definition: A short description of what the link shares, for example the member's name.

elements.label: Version
elements.definition: The protocol version.

elements.label: Extensions
elements.definition: Implementation-defined extensions.

elements.label: VHL Sharer FHIR base URL
elements.definition: Where the receiver performs UDAP discovery before a signed manifest request (ITI-YY5).
